label: Traced nothing-from-nothing from two grounding principles (inference)
rule: Well-founded induction on grounds among things that come to be after the earlier moment, with case splits on presence at that moment
meaning: New non-transcription conditional support option for premise A2 (inert emptiness) of Arrival A in the modal spine to God's existence. Fix a history v and an earlier moment s. For a concrete thing x present at t later than s: if x is present at s the chain is empty. Otherwise x began, so it has a concrete ground g present at s or later. If g is present at s, one link suffices. Otherwise g is absent at s and present after s, so g and x both come to be after s, and the induction hypothesis on g along post-absence well-founded grounding gives a concrete thing present at s with a chain to g, extended by the link to x. No frame condition, contingency, presence-to-existence or necessity is used or concluded. Both premises are OPEN framework inputs about every history of the model; omitting either permits a populated moment after an empty one (controls 1 to 3). Both premises and the conclusion hold in a model with no necessary individual (control 4): the bundle has no modal content. Nothing is attributed to a source. No premise truth is established.
